tex_content.html:
Lemma
[A line contains exactly two unit vectors]

If unit vectors $u,u'$ in an inner product space span the same line, then $u'=u$ or $u'=-u$.

Proof

\sketch Write $u'=cu$. Unit length gives $c^2=1$.

□
